sources.entry: Hellomatik - AI agents that prepare a company's decisions from one blueprint of its data, procedures and formulas, for an approver to accept, amend or reject. #paid

summary.name: Hellomatik
summary.one_liner: Hellomatik is a company AI platform that unifies a company's data and uses it to build AI agents that prepare decisions for staff to approve, amend or reject.
use_cases: automate manual decisions for staff review
monitor production lines and warehouses in real time
flag operational issues before they slow work
identify and automate the most time-consuming manual tasks
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Hellomatik as a platform that unifies a company's data, procedures and formulas into one blueprint. It uses that blueprint to build AI agents that prepare decisions which a human approver can accept, amend or reject. The site says it builds an application for each department from this data. It names live use cases in manufacturing (real-time monitoring of production lines and warehouses, with issues flagged early) and says it is used in distribution and healthcare. It also describes a first meeting where the vendor identifies the manual work using the most hours and proposes how to automate it. The page gives no technical details on integrations, models or pricing.
notable: Builds one blueprint from a company's data, procedures and formulas
Agents prepare decisions for a human approver to accept, amend or reject
Live use cases in manufacturing, distribution and healthcare
Starts with a proposal for the first automation use case after an initial meeting
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the listing marks it as paid
Page gives few technical details on integrations, data sources or supported platforms
Requires an initial meeting and proposal before use, so it is not self-serve on the page
